verdict.rationale: Customer.io's core product is background automation. Automations fire on events or segment membership and run multi-step workflows with goals, exit criteria and chained waits, without user intervention (docs-12, docs-30, docs-55, docs-18). AI-native users can build and manage these automations through the official MCP server, CLI and Claude plugin (docs-27, docs-1, docs-26), and the in-product agent can run recurring tasks automatically on a schedule (docs-33, docs-57). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that AI-built automations run reliably end-to-end; scheduled agent routines are documented only for reporting and audit tasks, not general autonomous actions.
